subject: the central square of a small fantasy market town in a river valley
camera: The camera stands on the cobbles a little east of the fountain, at eye level (1.6 m), in the middle of an open square about forty metres across. Buildings ring the square on every side with three gaps in the ring where streets leave it.

bearings.ahead: the mouth of the market street, climbing gently away between two rows of three-storey timber-framed houses, dark oak framing on pale lime plaster, upper storeys jettied out over the street; above and beyond their steep dark blue-grey slate roofs, the steep wooded slopes of dark broadleaf trees rising to the north
bearings.right: the long frontage of the Golden Dragon: a building half again as large as its neighbours, a gate arch through to an inner courtyard, a carved and painted dragon sign hanging from an iron bracket, its plaster catching the light
bearings.behind: the south side of the square, where the cobbled road runs out of it and down towards the water, and beyond the near roofs a smaller cluster of the same slate roofs on the far bank
bearings.left: the packed west quarter in shadow, house fronts shoulder to shoulder, cloth awnings in faded red and ochre over wooden trestles, baskets, barrels and sacks against the walls, and one narrow gap where a back lane leaves the square
bearings.up: open sky over the middle of the square, with lines of small triangular cloth banners strung between the upper storeys around its edge
bearings.down: worn grey granite cobbles with a shallow drainage channel down the middle, wet around the carved grey stone fountain, a coiled dragon spouting into a round basin
